errors.detail: ContactFlow has contactCompartment=//@compartments.1 and target=//@compartments.1. These should be different compartments. ContactFlow moves source to target upon contact with contactCompartment.
All 5 compartments have population=0. This indicates a critical extraction failure.
Model has 5 compartments but no externalSinks (death flows). Endemic disease models typically require death sinks.
Compartment 'Cholerae Bacterial Concentration' has no outgoing flow or sink. This breaks the flow chain.
Parameter '1/δ' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
Parameter 'κ' is declared but never referenced in any flow. It may have been extracted but not properly composed into the model.
